title: Top Fire Clara 170cm E-Cup Silicone Doll – T74
description:
Clara pairs Top Fire’s T74 head with the 170-2E silicone body: 170 cm tall, E-cup and approximately 30 kg. The factory gallery shows the Dark Tan finish. Choose from Top Fire’s standard silicone configuration menu, starting with the photographed head.

The listed USD base price includes estimated standard US air shipping. This is a made-to-order listing; the gallery styling is a photographic reference, not a promise that clothing or props are included.

Measurements and build

Package Size
156 x 42 x 31 cm

What can I customize?

Review the available head, skin, hair, eyes, nails, finish and factory upgrade choices in the configurator. Included features and paid upgrades are itemized there. Starter, Enthusiast and Collector are editable starting points, not separate dolls.

Is this the doll in the photos?

The gallery is Top Fire’s T74 Clara factory set. Keep the photographed head and finish or choose a different supported configuration. Production details can vary with your selections.

Shipping and care

US shipping is included in the displayed base price. See our shipping policy for destination details and browse Top Fire dolls to compare the range.

editorialIntro.heading: Cream, gold and auburn
editorialIntro.paragraph: The wooden shutters cast a gentle, sunlit glow across the light wood floor, enhancing the ivory curtains' soft drape. Clara stands with one hand absently touching her long, straight auburn hair, a delicate gold pendant glinting at her neck. The cream embroidery of her two-piece fashion outfit contrasts beautifully with the dark tan of her skin, while gold heels complement the ensemble. The neatly made bed adds to the room's tranquil, orderly atmosphere.

title: Top Fire Tessa 160cm F-Cup Silicone Doll – T75
description:
Tessa pairs Top Fire’s T75 head with the 160F silicone body: 160 cm tall, F-cup and approximately 30 kg. The factory gallery shows the Dark Tan finish. Choose from Top Fire’s standard silicone configuration menu, starting with the photographed head.

The listed USD base price includes estimated standard US air shipping. This is a made-to-order listing; the gallery styling is a photographic reference, not a promise that clothing or props are included.

Review the available head, skin, hair, eyes, nails, finish and factory upgrade choices in the configurator. Included features and paid upgrades are itemized there. Starter, Enthusiast and Collector are editable starting points, not separate dolls.

Is this the doll in the photos?

The gallery is Top Fire’s T75 Tessa factory set. Keep the photographed head and finish or choose a different supported configuration. Production details can vary with your selections.

Shipping and care

US shipping is included in the displayed base price. See our shipping policy for destination details and browse Top Fire dolls to compare the range.

editorialIntro.heading: Morning light, sharp contrasts
editorialIntro.paragraph: The kitchen hums with quiet energy, sunlight filtering through sheer curtains to dance on the warm wood table. Tessa stands beside it, her dark tan finish contrasting the room's soft tones. Her tousled platinum bob catches the light, complementing the black and cream embroidery of her outfit. A vase of cream roses sits on the table, their petals unfurling in the gentle glow. Tessa's hand rests lightly on the table, her black stockings and crystal-detail heels setting off the warm wood and cream roses. The pale bob and dark stockings give the portrait its strongest contrast.
